method: Owner-signed fast-forward main, matching Validate content CI, exact ZIP/runtime equality.
reviewIdentity: Claude claude-opus-5.5 and GPT gpt-6.1-sol; both CONFIRMED reviewed snapshot 04900b9c; seven serial runs, three fix commits
limits: Textual review only: no Kotlin, Android JVM, native, rendered-font, device or phone acceptance (no JDK on the continuation machine).

9 latent reading collisions (attested readings offered by other cards) are not drawable in the checked N1, All and Starter pools: 締 むすぶ (結), 縁 よる (依 因 夜 寄 由 選), 縁 え (図 柄 栄 重), 縁 よし (由), 縛 いましめる (警), 縦 はなつ (放 発), 縦 ゆるす (許), 縦 よし (由), 繰 くり (栗).
No KANJIDIC2 name-only reading can be drawn as a wrong option in the checked pools, and no one-holder Starter case exists.
3 lint warnings on existing word articles' Dictionary lines (綱, 緯度, 威張る) are pre-existing and out of scope.

Under the batch rule, readings with no declaring word article are listed but not quizzed. Six cards quiz only their on reading (継 ケイ, 緊 キン, 緯 イ, 織 シキ, 繕 ゼン, 罰 バツ) and nine only their kun reading (絞 しぼ.る, 綱 つな, 締 し.める, 緩 ゆる.い, 縁 ふち, 縄 なわ, 縛 しば.る, 縦 たて, 繰 く.る).
締 quizzes し.める (締める, 締め切り, 締め切る) although an automatic reading alignment of those words labels them し.まる; the card states the choice plainly and both reviewer families accepted it.
Some readings on the cards rest on a single dictionary entry or a Kanjipedia-only entry and are labelled as source-only where they appear; the card text is the authority for which.
Some titles share an English word with existing titles in another sense and are not excluded from each other's quiz options, except where a Notes bullet on the card says otherwise.
Each mnemonic is a modern-shape memory aid, labelled on the card as not etymology.
The reading audits are the author's Python ports of the Kotlin builder; no Kotlin cross-check was run.

The scope audits do not attribute reads made through shell commands or Python, so they list cards and other files as unread that the reports say were read; the later confirmations covered only the changed lines and the cumulative change.
Several judgments rest partly on live reads of Digital Daijisen, Kanjipedia and Jisho pages, not on pinned copies in the packet.
This exact published runtime and ZIP are verified, not the remaining N1 set.
A later contributor-only receipt commit needs its own CI and exported-tree equality check.
